scope: Exploratory response to observed v3 recapture; one new container per model, no confidence interval or production reliability claim
gpu_concurrency: one study GPU; wait for prior worker retirement; leave existing applications untouched
mode_order: random.Random(20261013 + round_id).shuffle; retained in raw record
profiles: 60 percent recurring short shape with changing tickets; 40 percent original diverse trace
arrivals: 5, 15, 30 requests/s for 60 seconds per mode and profile; fully drain phases
state_history: diverse profile before mixed profile in each mode; admission state persists across rates and profiles; resets between modes
admission: 128-call recent window, at least 32 observations, 8 hits and 12.5 percent frequency; maximum four capture attempts per configuration; no eviction or automatic recapture
setup: native model admission and fidelity before enabling adaptive; precheck inputs do not populate adaptive graph set
fidelity: archived successful request distributions matched by ID between modes per profile; final 128 checks can replay resident graphs but cannot admit new ones
overload: 128 in flight; all excess arrivals counted as dropped; 64 RPC inputs; GPU serialized
failure_policy: first request-error phase stops container and is retained; no retries until success
limits: CUDA fault root cause remains unknown; cold shape fallback cannot certify graph reliability; synthetic popularity mix; one container per model
